title: Flatten the candidate-session receipt wrapper
evidence: model.rs:1022-1096 stores a private Open/Publication(Box)/Disposal(Box) union inside the nominal open receipt; model.rs:1192 exposes only Head/OpenReceipt at the record level.
codec.rs:1176-1346 classifies and downcasts the nested receipt payload while encoding/decoding four existing canonical tags.

2026-09-07 caller validation: all candidate-session record/open-receipt named references under crates are confined to syndic-storage. session.rs:143-178 and 614-632 require a concrete open receipt before building its occupied proof; publication.rs:488-495,600-607,673-680,1002-1009,1028-1034,1206-1214,1374-1380,1484-1491,1569-1575,1651-1658 and publication/abandon_fresh.rs:90-97,224,269-276 immediately downcast a known publication/disposal key. Exhaustive non-head matches in staging/status.rs:99, staging/mutations.rs:28, mutation.rs:627,1857 and test_faults/draft_piece_staging.rs:231 need all three receipt variants. read/admission.rs:234-235 can match DisposalReceipt directly. proposal: Represent Head, OpenReceipt, PublicationReceipt and DisposalReceipt directly at the storage-record boundary, retaining concrete open receipts and removing the secondary classification/downcast layer. Update exhaustive internal callers together.
required_contract_changes: Preserve canonical V7 key/value tags 0-3, all request/root/history/generation validation and separately durable immutable receipts. Keep the opaque open-receipt constructor/getters and collision-proof API. The public storage Record enum gains explicit variants, so coordinate its Rust API declaration and exhaustive internal caller changes; no persisted format or product behavior change. No compatibility wrapper is needed for repository callers.

estimated_net_lines.basis: Approximately 45-55 lines from the 75-line nested model representation, 5-15 from redundant codec wrapping, and 35-55 from immediate downcasts/receipt constructors, less 25-35 for byte-equivalence fixtures and exhaustive caller adaptations: conservative 60-100 net. Includes only this receipt-layer change; coordinate caller overlap with publication/session audit and do not sum those same deletions twice. Not related to SA-001 admission payload savings.

verification: Existing candidate-session open/publication/disposal exact replay and collision cases; V7 canonical-byte equivalence fixtures for every tag and malformed tag/key pair.
Do not execute while implementation is paused.

Caller scan and focused bodies checked 2026-09-07; no callers require publication/disposal values to masquerade as open receipts. Keep wrong-kind natural-key rejection and owned-versus-borrowed Box extraction behavior.
confidence: high on behavior-preserving representation; medium on estimated net

title: Retain the authenticated durable tree; Ropey is not a replacement
evidence: All 11 source files and 7 test files were fully read before concluding the dependency fit screen.

Package design-draft-storage.md:28 requires immutable fanout-128/height-64 structures; design-schema-v7.md:175-205 and 637-709 require three authenticated structures, exact natural keys, bounded node work, durable progress and canonical replay.

Ropey v1.6.1 src/rope.rs:82-84 owns a private Arc<Node>; from_reader at 129 streams into a RopeBuilder and write_to at 216 writes every chunk. These are text import/export APIs rather than external durable-node loading.
Ropey len_lines at 247-248 returns line_break_count+1 even when empty; default Unicode/CR line features differ from Beryl's exact newline/empty-line summaries.
proposal: Retain the bespoke persistent/authenticated storage traversal. Ropey may be considered independently for a bounded resident text window if a real editor need is demonstrated, but that does not remove this storage implementation. Reuse im 15.1.0 negative screen from SA-009 as the persistent-collection comparison.
required_contract_changes: A whole-draft Rope replacement would require abandoning bounded active residency or adding a new durable-node layer, exact marker structures, Beryl line semantics and replay protocol. Those adapters retain the hard parts and provide no defensible positive storage net reduction under current authority.

estimated_net_lines.basis: Rejected dependency screen. Do not count the 19,626-line slice, required trees, codec families, or progress machinery as removable.

verification: No dependency installation, manifest change, build or benchmark performed.
Any future bounded-window use needs focused byte/char conversion, empty/LF line semantics, marker representation, resource and platform tests.
